test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Five men Z, X, H, I and J are sitting around a circular table, facing towards the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). Z is sitting second to the left of I. H is sitting second to the right of X. J is not the immediate neighbour of Z. Who is sitting third to the right of X?
solution:
Given: Five men Z, X, H, I and J. 

1) Z is sitting second to the left of I. 

2) J is not the immediate neighbour of Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3eabb0b4a3d84b1b634ed0860df71fa4da8d69bcac45e72985e92248cb4e863c.png] 

3) H is sitting second to the right of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5369e7bcbba39e046a1540642ed67ad6e21d8a6de907e9878dd76114f8ff24b.png] 

So, 'I' is sitting third to the right of X.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
